overview: The Griffins attempt to conquer Mount Everest after competitive friends mention they plan to scale the legendary peak. Things, however, are not looking up for the Griffins, as a wicked storm leaves them pinned down on the side of the mountain.

title: Ratings Guy
overview: Peter gets carried away when the Nielsen people select the Griffins to have their television-viewing habits monitored and he steals a number of the Nielsen boxes in hopes of controlling the airwaves.

title: The Old Man and the Big 'C'
overview: When Brian discovers that Carter Pewterschmidt’s pharmaceutical company is withholding the cure for cancer from the public in order to gain more profit, he and Stewie plot to expose the big secret that could change the world. Meanwhile, Quagmire reveals a hair-raising secret of his own.

title: Yug Ylimaf
overview: Brian abuses Stewie's time machine and causes reality to run in reverse. So the two must work together to set things right before Stewie is “unborn.”

title: Joe's Revenge
overview: When the criminal who shot Joe years ago, leaving Joe in a wheelchair, becomes a fugitive, Quagmire, Joe and Peter team up to hunt the bad guy down.

title: Lois Comes Out of Her Shell
overview: Peter tries to keep up with Lois as she goes through a midlife crisis; Stewie brings home a turtle from the park.

title: Friends Without Benefits
overview: When Meg learns her crush is gay and interested in Chris, she uses her brother to get closer to him.

title: Jesus, Mary and Joseph!
overview: As the Griffin family is preparing for Christmas, Peter tells his own version of the Nativity story.

title: Space Cadet
overview: To boost Chris' self-esteem, Peter and Lois send him to space camp. When camp ends and the Griffins come to pick Chris up, they accidentally are launched into outer space, and it's up to Chris to land the clan safely back on earth.

title: Brian's Play
overview: Brian writes a play that becomes a hit in Quahog, but loses his confidence when he finds that the play Stewie wrote is better than his.

title: The Giggity Wife
overview: When Peter, Quagmire and Joe visit the Harvard University campus, Quagmire accidentally marries a prostitute. In order to get out of his marriage, Quagmire pretends to be lovers with Peter.

title: Valentine's Day in Quahog
overview: On Valentine's Day, Meg goes on a date with a guy she met online, and Lois and Peter stay in bed all day; Brian is visited by his ex-girlfriends.

title: Chris Cross
overview: Chris leaves home to move in with Herbert while Stewie and Brian become obsessed with singer Anne Murray.

title: Call Girl
overview: When the Griffins find themselves in a financial bind, Lois is forced to find a job of her own. She gets discovered by a "voiceover" talent agent named Randy, who actually runs an adult-only phone line and pays his employees generously. As Lois settles into her new gig, she hears Peter's voice on the other end of the line.

title: Turban Cowboy
overview: When Peter, Quagmire and Joe need a jolt in their mundane lives, they decide to go skydiving. But after an unfortunate accident, Peter ends up in the hospital, where he befriends Mahmoud, who convinces Peter to convert to Islam. Quagmire and Joe are suspicious of Mahmoud's intentions and try to stop the friendship from progressing.

title: 12 and a Half Angry Men
overview: When Mayor West is put on trial for murder, Brian is the lone holdout voting "not guilty," and he tries to persuade his fellow jurors that there's a reasonable doubt of the Mayor's guilt.

title: Bigfat
overview: Peter, Quagmire and Joe take a trip to Canada. But after Peter gets lost for two months, a feral Peter returns to his family with no ability to communicate intelligently.

title: Total Recall
overview: After teddy bear Rupert gets recalled, Stewie stops at nothing to get back his beloved best friend. Meanwhile, When Peter falls ill and can't compete in his bowling tournament, Peter becomes jealous when Lois fills in for him.

title: Save the Clam
overview: When the owner of The Drunken Clam is killed, Peter and the guys must find a way to save the bar, after the bank threatens to close it. Meanwhile, Meg gets a part-time job at a funeral home.

title: Farmer Guy
overview: Peter buys a farm and becomes a meth dealer.

title: Roads to Vegas
overview: Duplicates of Brian and Stewie each see a road trip differently.

title: No Country Club for Old Men
overview: The Griffins are invited to join the prestigious Barrington Country Club and get thrown out.

title: Finders Keepers
overview: Peter is convinced that a restaurant placemat is a treasure map. Word quickly spreads about the alleged cache, sparking a city-wide search and turning the citizens of Quahog against each other.

title: Vestigial Peter
overview: After a vestigial twin grows out of Peter's neck, which he names Chip, he eventually starts realizing that people like Chip more than they like him, so Peter has him amputated. However, after Peter gets into trouble, he realizes he needs Chip more than ever.

title: Quagmire's Quagmire
overview: Quagmire dates a woman named Sonja, who is just as sexually active as he is, but things take a turn for the worse when she kidnaps him to be her sex slave, so Peter, Joe and Ida must search the seedy back alleys of Quahog to rescue him. In the meantime, Brian, Stewie and Rupert get involved in a most unusual love triangle.

title: A Fistful of Meg
overview: When Meg spills her lunch on the new kid at school, he makes plans to end her. Meanwhile, Peter keeps harassing Brian in the nude until it reaches the breaking point.

title: Boopa-Dee Bappa-Dee
overview: The Griffins go to Italy and are faced with annoying immigration laws after Peter destroys their passports.

title: Life of Brian
overview: Stewie and Brian travel back in time to 17th-century Jamestown and make too many close calls with changing history. Stewie decides to destroy his time machine, but comes to regret it when Brian dies after being hit by a car. Devastated by his death, the Griffin family goes out and adopts another dog from the pet store, Vinnie, who is quickly accepted by all the members of the Griffin family, other than Stewie, who can't get over the loss of Brian.

title: Into Harmony's Way
overview: When Peter and Quagmire discover that their singing voices create beautiful harmony together, they form a singing/songwriting team, in the vein of Simon and Garfunkel. However, tensions run high when fame gets to Peter’s head.

title: Christmas Guy
overview: When Carter Pewterschmidt cancels the annual Quahog Christmas carnival, because he hates the holiday, Peter must transform his father-in-law from a Scrooge into a hometown hero in order to salvage the event. Meanwhile, Stewie devises a master plan to get the one and only thing he wants for Christmas.

title: Peter Problems
overview: When Peter gets fired for crashing a forklift into a business meeting, Lois takes a job at the grocery store while Peter becomes a stay-at-home dad — which leads to poor bedroom performance.

title: Grimm Job
overview: From Grimm to Griffin, three classic fairy tales get a new Quahog spin, including "Jack and the Beanstalk," "Little Red Riding Hood" and "Cinderella."

title: Brian's a Bad Father
overview: Brian tries to use Dylan's television connections to further his career.

title: Mom's the Word
overview: When Peter's mother dies, he befriends her longtime pal Evelyn, who tries to seduce him. In the meantime, Stewie feels despair upon dealing with the realities of death.

title: 3 Acts of God
overview: Peter grows frustrated when players on opposing teams continue to thank God after defeating his beloved New England Patriots football team, so he and the guys embark on a global quest to find God and ask Him to stop interfering with the outcome of professional football games.

title: Fresh Heir
overview: Chris becomes the heir to Carter's fortune but refuses to accept the money; Peter desperately tries to keep the wealth in the family.

title: Secondhand Spoke
overview: Peter takes up smoking cigarettes, and is approached by Mr. Stone, an advertising executive who wants Peter to be the face of his anti-smoking campaign under the caveat that Peter continues to smoke. Meanwhile, Stewie helps Chris battle bullies at school.

title: Herpe, the Love Sore
overview: Brian gives Stewie an STD. Meanwhile, Peter and the guys fight back when another group claims their booth at The Drunken Clam.

title: The Most Interesting Man in the World
overview: When Peter takes Stewie to the park for some quality father-son time, he mistakenly takes the wrong baby home, prompting Lois to call him an idiot. Determined to prove to her that he's a responsible adult, Peter goes on a business trip to Chicago and returns as an intelligent, classy person.

title: Baby Got Black
overview: Chris is forbidden to see Jerome's daughter Pam, so when the kids run away together, Jerome and Peter must work together to find them.

title: Meg Stinks!
overview: Meg has fun partying with Peter when he takes her to a college for an interview. Brian must learn how to live in the wild when he gets sprayed by a skunk and is prohibited from entering the house.

title: He's Bla-ack!
overview: Cleveland returns to town, but is instantly banned from spending time with Peter when Lois and Donna get into a big fight over parenting.

title: Chap Stewie
overview: When Peter and Chris interrupt Stewie’s TV time, the angry baby goes back in time to break up Peter and Lois so he’s never conceived, but is shocked when he is reborn into a “Downton Abbey”-esque British household.

title: The Simpsons Guy
overview: In a special hour-long crossover with The Simpsons, the Griffins meet the Simpson family when they end up in Springfield after their car is stolen. Stewie takes lessons in pranks and skateboarding from Bart, while Lisa discovers - to her annoyance - that Meg is as good at playing the saxophone as she is. Peter bonds with Homer as they locate the missing car, but then they fight after Peter loses his job when Pawtucket Patriot is revealed to be a copy of Duff Beer.

title: The Book of Joe
overview: Peter helps Joe fulfill his dream of getting a book published, only to take over as the writer. In the meantime, Brian develops an extreme thirst for exercise.

title: Baking Bad
overview: Peter and Lois decide to open a cookie store, but Peter ruins things when he decides to bring clients in his own way.

title: Brian the Closer
overview: Brian's cosmetic surgery leads him down a new career path as a real estate agent, which gets him into trouble with Quagmire.

title: Turkey Guys
overview: On the night before Thanksgiving, Brian and Peter drunkenly devour the holiday bird, and then must go out to find a replacement. In Peter absence, Chris attempts to step up and become the man of the house.

title: The 2,000-Year-Old Virgin
overview: After running into Jesus at the Quahog Mall, Peter is stunned to discover that the Son of God is still a virgin. So, he enlists Quagmire and Cleveland to help him throw Jesus the best birthday ever by finding a way to help him become a man.

title: Stewie, Chris & Brian's Excellent Adventure
overview: To help Chris ace his ninth grade history class, Stewie and Brian employ the time travel machine for educational purposes. Not surprisingly, all three get stuck in the past.

title: Our Idiot Brian
overview: When Brian takes the SATs for Meg but doesn't do very well, the family starts to doubt his intelligence; Peter tries to show Brian the upside of being stupid.

title: This Little Piggy
overview: Meg is thrilled to be recruited as a model, but it turns out to be for a very specific type of modeling: the foot-fetish industry. Meanwhile, Brian accompanies Stewie on an open-road adventure when Stewie decides he wants to experience life outside of preschool.

title: Quagmire's Mom
overview: After discovering his checks are actually a large size post-it pad, Peter demands he have access to the checking account. While at the bank, Peter & Lois discover that his first name is actually Justin, so Peter embraces his new partying “bro” lifestyle. Meanwhile, Joe arrests Glenn after he sleeps with an underage girl, which leads to an unexpected reunion.

title: Encyclopedia Griffin
overview: Peter, Quagmire, Joe and Cleveland form a neighborhood detective agency, and are stunned to discover that Chris is a thief. Meanwhile, Lois is worried about Chris' delusional relationship with his new girlfriend, but also sees it as an opportunity for Peter to copy Chris' romantic gestures.

title: Stewie Is Enceinte
overview: Brian decides he doesn't want to hang out with Stewie anymore, so Stewie tries to save their relationship by having a baby ... or seven ... by using Brian's DNA to impregnate himself. Meanwhile, Peter, Joe, Quagmire and Cleveland attempt to make a viral video.

title: Dr. C and the Women
overview: Meg gets a new job at the airport, where she's instantly popular for being the hottest employee there. Meanwhile, Cleveland becomes a therapist and starts giving Peter and Lois relationship advice, but Peter quickly becomes frustrated and threatens to tell Donna a big secret about what went down at Cleveland's bachelor party.

title: #JOLO
overview: When Peter accidentally discovers a missing child, he is hailed as town hero. Meanwhile, Joe quits his job and heads to Niagara Falls to live life to the fullest.

title: Once Bitten
overview: After attending obedience school, Brian becomes much more submissive, and Peter realizes he misses his old, feistier pal. Meanwhile, Chris makes a new friend at school, but feels betrayed when he discovers it was all a ploy to get closer to Meg.

title: Roasted Guy
overview: Peter's friends roast him. With his feelings hurt, he seeks refuge by befriending a group of gossipy women.

title: Fighting Irish
overview: Peter claims he would beat Liam Neeson (guest voice Liam Neeson) in a fight, but when he is put to the test, he learns that winning is tougher than it seems. Meanwhile, Stewie becomes jealous when Lois decides to be a class mom and starts paying more attention to the other kids over him.

title: Take My Wife
overview: Lois books a fun couple’s vacation in the Bahamas. But, much to Peter’s surprise, it turns out to be a marriage counseling program instead. Meanwhile, Carter watches the kids at home and becomes frustrated that they’re too into their electronics to play games the old-fashioned way. So he tries to fix it himself.

title: Pilling Them Softly
overview: Stewie is diagnosed with ADD and prescribed Adderall, which Brian takes to write a 2000-page proposal to pitch to author George R.R. Martin at a book convention. Meanwhile, Quagmire and Peter compete, Iron Chef-style, to determine which of them gets to keep his new cooking show.

title: Papa Has a Rollin' Son
overview: For Father’s Day, the guys track down Joe’s estranged father. But when Joe explains that his dad is intolerant of people with disabilities, Peter steps in and pretends to be Joe. Meanwhile, Stewie’s doctor tells him that he’ll only grow to be 5’1”, so he hangs out with Tiny Tom Cruise to understand what it’s like to be short.

title: Guy Robot
overview: Stewie doesn’t like Brian’s stand-up comedy jokes, so the two of them fight. To get back at Brian and make him jealous, Stewie builds a robot friend. But when the robot outsmarts Stewie and dumps him, Brian and Stewie reunite. Meanwhile, Lois forces Peter to get a new mattress.

title: Peternormal Activity
overview: The guys go to an abandoned asylum seeking inspiration for a new horror movie idea, but end up accidentally killing a man they think is keeping them hostage. Wracked with guilt, they each try to pin the murder on someone else. Meanwhile, Stewie is on a mission to destroy Brian's glasses because he's annoyed by how pretentious Brian's been acting when he wears them

title: Peter, Chris & Brian
overview: Peter gets a check in the mail from the sale of his mother's home and he remembers that all of his old porn is still in there. When he returns to retrieve his stash, he finds a "to Peter from Peter" tape and realizes that his life has amounted to nothing. Reeling from his own failures, Peter then attempts to fix Chris before it's too late, and forces his son to spend time with Brian.

title: Peter's Sister
overview: Peter’s sister, Karen, decides to come for Thanksgiving and bullies Peter the same way Meg treats him. While Meg is at first amused, she later feels badly and decides to help Peter train to defeat his sister in a wrestling match. Meanwhile, to avoid overeating on Thanksgiving, Stewie and Brian decide to go on a cleanse, which Stewie takes one step too far.

title: Hot Pocket-Dial
overview: Quagmire admits that he is in love with Lois. Unfortunately, he proclaims his love while he has accidentally pocket-dialed Peter. Peter is furious and Brian takes it upon himself to fix the situation.

title: Brokeback Swanson
overview: When Joe is trampled in a local running of the bulls and becomes a quadriplegic, the guys find it too difficult to hang around him. Meanwhile, Brian sleeps with a married woman, and when the husband returns home, he pretends to be the family’s new dog.

title: A Shot in the Dark
overview: When Peter’s couch is stolen from his front lawn, the guys form a neighborhood watch group. While on duty, Peter sees someone trying to climb into Cleveland’s house and he shoots him. Peter is then arrested and charged with a hate crime. Meanwhile, Cleveland is touched when Peter finally admits to the accident, so he takes the fall for the crime and Peter is exonerated.

title: Candy, Quahog Marshmallow
overview: Peter, Cleveland and Joe come across a VHS tape called “Winter/Summer” an Asian soap opera that Quagmire starred in when he was living in Korea. Unable to find the final episode of the series, the guys travel to Korea to find it and Quagmire is reunited with his old lover. Meanwhile, Stewie worries he might become a redhead.

title: The Peanut Butter Kid
overview: When their bank accounts begin to run dry, the Griffins look for ways to make money. Stewie gets cast in a peanut butter commercial and becomes the money maker for the family. Meanwhile, Lois and Peter become crazy show business parents and Brian helps Stewie realize that he does not want to be a child actor.

title: Scammed Yankees
overview: Lois and her mom, Babs, have a relaxing spa day, leaving Peter to entertain Lois’ father, Carter. The boys fall for an email scam, and have to go to Africa to get their money back. Meanwhile, Brian pursues Meg’s friend, Patty.

title: An App a Day
overview: Peter overloads his phone with apps. He buys a new phone with more memory, gives his old phone to Chris, and hilarity ensues. Stewie joins a tennis club and invites Brian to be his tennis partner.

title: Underage Peter
overview: Mayor West raises the drinking age to 50. Because of dog years, Brian is the only one old enough to buy alcohol, so Peter makes him buy all of his booze.

title: A Lot Going On Upstairs
overview: When Stewie refuses to sleep in his own bed because of nightmares, Peter can’t stand it, so he goes to sleep in the attic. Peter turns the attic into a man cave and all of the guys begin hanging out there, which makes Lois incredibly angry. Meanwhile, Brian helps Stewie overcome his fears by building a device to go into his nightmares and defeat his demons.

title: The Heartbreak Dog
overview: Meg begins working at a retirement community and starts stealing from the residents. Then Chris finds out and wants in on the heist. When the residents catch them, they blackmail them and force the thieves to listen to all of their boring stories.

title: Take a Letter
overview: To pay for Stewie’s private school, Lois becomes a postal worker. She finds a letter from Peter that was never sent to his old fling, Gretchen, dated a week before their marriage. When Gretchen tries to come between Lois and Peter, Lois has a plan of her own.

title: The New Adventures of Old Tom
overview: Peter gets lost in the mall overnight after his family abandons him. Meanwhile, Brian pretends to be a millionaire to win over a girl.

title: Run, Chris, Run
overview: To everyone’s surprise, Chris wins homecoming king. However, Meg finds out that the cool kids plan to prank him during the homecoming ceremony, so they go to the school to investigate. Meanwhile, Cleveland starts hanging out with Jerome, the bartender. So Peter and the guys try to replace him.

title: Road to India
overview: Brian falls in love with a tech support worker in India, so he and Stewie travel there to find her. Meanwhile, Joe invites Peter to his bingo night, but when Peter becomes the new center of attention, Lois helps Joe reclaim the group.

title: The Boys in the Band
overview: Stewie and Brian form a band aimed at children, but face a breakup when they set their eyes on the same girl. Meanwhile, Chris gets a job as Quagmire's personal assistant for his sex life.

title: Bookie of the Year
overview: Brian and Lois decide it's time for Chris to work out his anger management issues by taking up a sport. Chris surprises everyone and becomes a star baseball pitcher, which turns Peter into a gambling father, as he bets on his son's baseball games. Meanwhile, Stewie, Brian and Frank Sinatra Jr. attempt to open an Italian restaurant.

title: American Gigg-olo
overview: After the local airline pilots go on strike, Quagmire looks for new work and becomes a gigolo. When his clients begin to avoid paying for his services, he asks Peter for help getting his money. Meanwhile, Brian is kicked off Peter’s health insurance, so he gets a job at a hardware store, until Stewie gets him fired and things get medical.

title: Inside Family Guy
overview: Family Guy takes viewers behind the scenes of a regular production week, with James Woods as the guide. See the ins-and-outs of what goes into the making of an episode and watch the drama unfold as Peter is replaced and ends up in the office of Fox Television Group Chairmen and CEOs Dana Walden and Gary Newman to pitch his very own new series.

title: Chris Has Got a Date, Date, Date, Date, Date
overview: Taylor Swift agrees to go to a homecoming dance with Chris after he asks her via online video. However, when she starts to fall for him, her music takes a hit. Meanwhile, Peter decides to try a new profession and sees firsthand what it's like to be an Uber driver.

title: Hot Shots
overview: In order to "save" Stewie from autism, Peter and Lois decide not to vaccinate him and then proceed to convince the rest of Quahog to follow suit. Stewie runs away to save himself from diseases until Sean Penn swoops in to save the day and brings vaccines to the whole town.

title: High School English
overview: In an anthology episode, the cast reenacts three classic pieces of literature commonly taught in high school: "The Great Gatsby," "The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn" and "Of Mice and Men".

title: Carter and Tricia
overview: Carter buys the Pawtucket Patriot brewery and decides to cut some corners to save a few bucks. Peter overhears the plan and runs and tells investigative journalist Tricia Takanawa about Carter's plan to use toxic chemicals in the beer cans. Meanwhile, Brian's drivers' license has expired and he enlists Stewie as an instructor.

title: How the Griffin Stole Christmas
overview: Peter fills in for Santa at the mall, but lets the power go to his head when he realises just what he can get away with. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian become holiday office-party crashers.

title: Passenger Fatty-Seven
overview: Quagmire lands free plane tickets for the guys' trip to San Francisco, but they begin to doubt his flying abilities after getting a look at the auto-pilot function. While in the air, sudden events give Quagmire's skills a run for the money.

title: Gronkowsbees
overview: Rob Gronkowski moves into the house behind the Griffins. Stewie raises bees and sells honey at the farmers market.

title: Peter's Def Jam
overview: The guys try to start a podcast, but Peter goes solo and branches out as a DJ. Meanwhile, back at the Griffin home, Lois' allergy forces Brian to move into Stewie's bedroom and the two have roommate difficulties.

title: The Finer Strings
overview: The guys decide to form a string quartet, but Peter doesn't make the cut. Meanwhile, Brian is forced to be Carter's seeing eye dog and enjoys the life of luxury a little too much

title: The Dating Game
overview: Quagmire discovers the “dating” app Tinder, forcing Peter, Joe and Cleveland to intervene and save him from his soul-sucking hedonism. Meanwhile, Stewie finds out that he has scoliosis and learns the perks of his latest diagnosis

title: Cop and a Half-Wit
overview: Peter helps Joe out with several crime cases, but when Joe tries to take all the credit, Peter gets extremely angry. Meanwhile, Brian convinces Stewie to join a football team and panics when he gets a concussion.

title: Saturated Fat Guy
overview: In an attempt to avoid eating the healthy food that Lois forces him to eat, Peter opens up his own food truck with fattening foods. Meanwhile, Meg joins a roller derby team, despite Chris thinking it’s too dangerous

title: Peter's Lost Youth
overview: Peter gets jealous of Lois when she upstages him at a Red Sox fantasy baseball camp. Meanwhile, Stewie runs away from home when Meg is left to babysit him

title: The Peter Principal
overview: Peter becomes the temporary principal at the high school, and Meg uses his new power to get even with her bullies. Meanwhile, Brian and Stewie open a bed & breakfast that quickly turns into a brothel.

title: Dearly Deported
overview: When Chris' Mexican girlfriend, Isabella, gets deported, he volunteers to take care of her twin babies. After learning that Isabella can't come back to the U.S., the Griffins go to Mexico to return her children.

title: A House Full of Peters
overview: Peter's past as a sperm donor catches up to him when many of his children show up unannounced to his house.

title: Emmy-Winning Episode
overview: Tired of not winning an Emmy, Peter embarks on his own For Your Consideration campaign for Family Guy by making the show more like Emmy-winning shows - and no category is off limits.

title: Foxx in the Men House
overview: Peter becomes friends with a cool, handsome paramedic named Stryker Foxx. Wrapped up in his newfound "coolness," he soon dumps Quagmire, Joe and Cleveland.

title: Nanny Goats
overview: Peter and Louis find themselves with a golden opportunity to reconnect as a couple after Lois' parents get a nanny to take care of the children for them.

title: Follow the Money
overview: Chris receives a special one-dollar bill as a birthday present, but he quickly loses it and the dollar passes into the possession of everybody in Quahog.

title: Three Directors
overview: The story of Peter's firing from the brewery, as told in the styles of Quentin Tarantino, Wes Anderson, and Michael Bay.

title: The D in Apartment 23
overview: When Brian posts an offensive tweet that goes viral and the rest of the Griffins are also treated as outcasts, he's forced to move out of the Griffin house.

title: Petey IV
overview: Vladimir Putin comes to Quahog after Peter writes to him about an alternate ending to the Russian version of Rocky IV (1985).

title: Crimes and Meg's Demeanor
overview: Peter encourages Meg to attend a high school party, where she takes up drinking, which both concerns and delights her father. Meanwhile, Brian begins spying on his neighbors and suspects Principal Shepherd of a crime.

title: Don't Be a Dickens at Christmas
overview: In this special holiday episode, a selfish Peter loses his Christmas spirit and is visited by ghosts of Christmas past, present and future who take him on a journey around Quahog in the style of Charles Dickens' "A Christmas Carol".

title: Boy (Dog) Meets Girl (Dog)
overview: Brian is smitten with a female show dog and enters a show dog competition in which the winner gets to breed her; Peter and Lois go to extreme measures to try to convince Chris that Arthur Valentine doesn't exist.

title: Dog Bites Bear
overview: Stewie and Brian get into a friendship-ending fight after Brian commits a terrible act to one of Stewie's beloved toys. Meanwhile, Peter refuses to wash his hand after meeting his favorite breakfast cereal mascot, Boo Berry.

title: Send in Stewie, Please
overview: When Stewie gets sent to see his school's child psychologist for a surprising session, he reveals major secrets about himself.

title: V Is for Mystery
overview: Stewie and Brian are detectives who embark on solving a string of mysterious murders set in Victorian-era London.

title: Veteran Guy
overview: After Peter and the guys get caught pretending to be military veterans and are found guilty of the Stolen Valor Act, a judge sentences them to join the U.S. Coast Guard.

title: The Woof of Wall Street
overview: Brian convinces Stewie to teach him how to invest in the stock market after learning Stewie has a knack for making money from it. Meanwhile, Peter, Quagmire, Cleveland, and Joe look after the Drunken Clam while Jerome is away.

title: 'Family Guy' Through The Years
overview: FAMILY GUY is reimagined as a series that’s been on the air for 60 years and, in a special retrospective, it looks back at the cultural events and issues that were tackled on the show in the 1950s, '60s and '70s.

title: Switch the Flip
overview: To help get Brian's life in order, Stewie and Brian swap bodies using a machine that Stewie invents, but chaos quickly ensues around Quahog when the machine goes haywire.

title: HTTPete
overview: To help promote the brewery to millennials, Peter adopts the millennial lifestyle, and his methods soon attract the attention of a high-powered Silicon Valley executive.

title: The Unkindest Cut
overview: Quagmire's most treasured body part gets cut off in a freak accident and he is forced to learn how to live without it. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian search for Mort after learning there is a $10,000 reward for turning him into the police for his involvement in a drug scam.

title: Are You There God? It's Me, Peter
overview: After Peter falls into a coma, Peter meets God face-to-face, which leads him to ask some of life's tough questions.

title: Married... with Cancer (1)
overview: Brian quickly falls in love with a woman, and after receiving devastating news regarding her cancer diagnosis, he proposes marriage.

title: Dead Dog Walking (2)
overview: Brian's marriage to Jess doesn't go as planned, especially after her miraculous cancer recovery, so at Peter's suggestion, Brian lets himself go, leading Jess to make a surprising decision.

title: Pal Stewie
overview: Stewie is surprised when he makes friends with another boy his age, but later taken aback when he learns that Stewie wasn't invited to his birthday party.

title: Big Trouble in Little Quahog
overview: Stewie invents a shrinking machine that shrinks him and Brian down to microscopic size.

title: Regarding Carter
overview: Lois receives a surprising birthday present from her father, Carter Pewterschmidt, that leads to an unfortunate accident leaving him dependent on Lois and the Griffin's care.

title: Stand By Meg
overview: After Meg saves Stewie from a choking incident, Stewie makes it his personal mission to create a better life for Meg. Meanwhile, Chris is sent to a vocational school.

title: The Griffin Winter Games
overview: To the surprise of all the Griffins, Meg makes the U.S. Olympic team as a biathlete and competes in the Winter Olympics.

title: Con Heiress
overview: Stewie and Brian compete for the inheritance of a wealthy, older heiress. Meanwhile, Peter and Chris battle for Mr. Herbert's affection.

title: Pawtucket Pete
overview: The Pawtucket Brewery hires new bosses, who decide to change the company's mascot. In an attempt to be crowned the new face of Pawtucket Ale, Peter and Brian go head-to-head.

title: Hefty Shades of Gray
overview: After Peter's hair turns white from a ghost-hunting adventure in his house with the guys, his new look grabs the attention of local news anchor Tom Tucker. Under Tucker's guidance, he learns the ways of reporting fake news, and soon becomes a senior crime analyst on Quahog's Channel 5 News. Meanwhile, Brian and Stewie attempt to help Chris improve his dating game.

title: Trump Guy
overview: Peter is given the position of the next White House Press Secretary and the Griffin family gets ready to make a move to Washington, D.C.

title: Bri, Robot
overview: Brian worries about the legacy he's leaving behind, so Stewie makes a robot duplicate as a living biography.

title: Trans-Fat
overview: Peter is mistakenly identified as transgender, which leads to an unexpected event and an important learning lesson.

title: Family Guy Lite
overview: After a mishap at work, Peter decides to take his health more seriously and diet with the help of Quagmire, Joe, and Cleveland. When Lois takes a stab at writing a romantic fantasy novel, a curious Brian and Stewie investigate to find out who she might have a crush.

title: No Giggity, No Doubt
overview: When the guys volunteer to chaperone the high school prom, Quagmire hits it off with Courtney only to discover that she is his daughter. To his and the gang's surprise, Quagmire makes a serious effort to embrace parenting Courtney, joining Peter and Meg on an ill-fated father-daughter camping trip.

title: You Can't Handle the Booth
overview: The Griffins provide DVD commentary on a recent episode and reveal never-before-told drama between Peter and Lois.

title: Island Adventure
overview: In search of Stewie's cherished big wheel tricycle, that Peter threw out, Stewie and Brian embark on an adventure to "Garbage Island," a giant floating mass of trash out in the sea. Meanwhile, Lois tries to help Quagmire elevate his dating game, as he courts a middle-aged woman.

title: Throw It Away
overview: After Lois reads a new book on the joys of decluttering, she challenges the rest of the Griffins to throw anything out of the house that does not spark joy. While all starts out well, Lois soon takes the decluttering to a surprising extreme.

title: Girl, Internetted
overview: When Meg suddenly becomes internet famous, she and an excited Peter work together to build her following and create content for her new image that revolves around unhealthy eating. Meanwhile, Brian and Stewie revel in a new ride while Brian's car gets repaired.

title: Adam West High
overview: When Brian's proposition to rename Quahog's high school "Adam West High," to honor the late Mayor West, is successful, he feels encouraged to run for office as Quahog's new mayor. The race takes a turn when Quagmire campaigns against Brian for the open seat.

title: Yacht Rocky
overview: When the brewery announces it will be firing one employee, Peter is nervous he will be the one let go; the family departs on a Yacht Rock cruise that doesn't go as expected.

title: Bri-Da
overview: Peter and his friends are sick of forgetting the million-dollar business ideas they come up with while drinking, so they strap on Joe's police body cams to record their every move. Meanwhile, Quagmire is trying to come to terms with an unexpected family development.

title: Absolutely Babulous
overview: When Stewie receives a participation medal in his school's toddler games, he begins to question everything he has ever won. Meanwhile, Peter causes a fight between Lois' parents and must repair the damage he caused.

title: Disney's The Reboot
overview: The network decides that it's time to explore some unique ways to reboot the series. When three versions of the reboots are shown to a focus group, the feedback takes some surprising turns.

title: Cat Fight
overview: When Quagmire opens a cat café in town, Brian decides to take a stand to get the café shut down. Meanwhile, when Meg and Chris get in trouble at school, Lois becomes nervous and decides they need to go to church camp in order to find their way.

title: Peter & Lois' Wedding
overview: The Wi-Fi goes out in the Griffin house, leaving the family with nothing to do for the evening. In order to keep the family entertained, Peter and Lois decide to tell the kids the story of how they met and fell in love in the '90s.

title: Heart Burn
overview: To celebrate Peter and Lois' wedding anniversary, the Griffins present their own versions of three well-known love stories.

title: Shanksgiving
overview: Peter gets himself arrested to avoid Lois' special Thanksgiving dinner; A secret that Stewie's been keeping from everyone is revealed.

title: Christmas Is Coming
overview: When Meg takes Stewie to the mall to meet Santa, she has a surprising response. Meanwhile, Stewie is entirely scarred from the same experience and Brian tries to help him process it.

title: Connie's Celica
overview: When Lois gets a job as the music teacher at Chris and Meg's school, a mean student decides to make Lois the target of her antics.

title: Short Cuts
overview: When Brian accidentally becomes a local hero, an old street pal, and now a successful millionaire dog, reaches out and tries to convince him to get neutered. Meanwhile, Lois gets a pixie cut against Peter's wishes, so Peter retaliates by trying to out-embarrass her.

title: Undergrounded
overview: Peter secretly gets a credit card and overspends the family money, so Lois grounds him. To plan the perfect escape, he builds a tunnel leading directly to The Drunken Clam.

title: Rich Old Stewie
overview: Stewie's future life could not be going any better, living as a wealthy, old Mr. Burns-type man, until his retirement is interrupted by Brian, who brings news that Peter is dying.

title: The Movement
overview: When Peter starts coaching for Quahog's minor league baseball team, he gets constipated during the national anthem and must kneel, unintentionally becoming the face of racial justice.

title: Baby Stewie
overview: Stewie builds a DNA-altering machine that will allow him to remain smart forever, but the invention has the adverse effect and he instead transforms into what he should have always been - an actual baby.

title: Start Me Up
overview: Peter's non-stop sweating becomes a liability at his company, so his boss tells him to work from home. Meanwhile, after Stewie and Chris cause thousands of dollars in damage to an electronics store, the two create a fake Kickstarter campaign with Brian to pay back the money.

title: Coma Guy
overview: With a newfound love for rocking out to Van Halen, Peter gets in a car accident and falls into a coma.

title: Better Off Meg
overview: When Meg is erroneously reported to have died in a car crash, she goes along with the story to start a new life elsewhere. Meanwhile, the Griffins experience a life without Meg Griffin.

title: Holly Bibble
overview: Cooped up in a hotel room due to a big storm, the Griffins pass the time by reimagining three stories from the Bible.

title: Movin' In (Principal Shepherd's Song)
overview: Principal Shepherd moves in with the Griffins after he is fired for fat-shaming Chris at school. Meanwhile, Brian sues Stewie for writing a series of children's books which portray him as an idiot.

title: Stewie's First Word
overview: Stewie finally says his first word, and it's a swear. When Lois is shunned by the other moms, she tries to figure out where Stewie could have possibly learned it.

title: The Talented Mr. Stewie
overview: Stewie "breaks up with" Rupert after learning that he used to belong to Chris. Unable to get over his feelings of betrayal, Stewie decides to take action.

title: Boys & Squirrels
overview: When Peter injures himself and a family of squirrels in a chainsaw accident, Chris and Stewie take in one of the injured rodents to nurse it back to health. Meanwhile, a chiropractor fixes Peter's injury by realigning his spine - and restoring him to his "true height" of 6'5".

title: CutawayLand
overview: Peter and Lois accidentally set up a cutaway gag together, which somehow transports them into the cutaway itself.

title: La Famiglia Guy
overview: When Joe asks Peter to be the godfather to his daughter, Peter commits to his mistaken interpretation of the role so much that he becomes a real gangster.

title: Meg's Wedding
overview: Meg plans her wedding to an unexpected Quahog resident. Meanwhile, Peter finds a new vest and on one of many adventures fitting for his new attire, his arms are torn off and he is left with tiny hands that have yet to grow back.

title: Wild Wild West
overview: Lois and Peter are divided by differing views on who the next Mayor of Quahog should be. Upset at Lois' first choice, Peter seeks out the late Mayor Adam West's cousin, Wild Wild West.

title: Pawtucket Pat
overview: Brian's new job as a journalist leads him to uncover that Pawtucket Pat, Quahog's hero and brewery founder, took part in racist actions against Native Americans. The town becomes divided on whether or not to remove the statue that commemorates him.

title: The First No L
overview: When the family fails to help Lois with the Christmas shopping, she walks out on the family and the Griffins must try to save Christmas on their own.

title: Fecal Matters
overview: When Peter makes it through a bad flu season without getting sick, the hospital asks him to volunteer as a nurse, but he finds himself at a crossroads when his mortal enemy, The Giant Chicken, is admitted to the ER. Meanwhile, Brian receives his genetic test results and learns he is part cat, causing him to have an identity crisis.

title: Boy's Best Friend
overview: Brian bonds with the son of his new girlfriend. Meanwhile, Peter, Quagmire and Cleveland take a joy ride in Joe's new classic corvette.

title: And Then There's Fraud
overview: After attending a baseball game, Peter and Chris are inspired to start a memorabilia business. Meanwhile, Stewie tries to combat aging by getting plastic surgery, but ends up taking it too far.

title: PeTerminator
overview: Stewie designs a "Terminator" Peter robot to destroy Lois for trying to feed him broccoli, but when things don't go according to plan, Stewie and Brian must go on a Terminator-esque mission to save Stewie's life.

title: The Marrying Kind
overview: Stewie gets a mail order bride from Ukraine and experiences domestic life. Meanwhile, Peter and Chris become addicted to free hotel breakfast buffets.

title: Customer of the Week
overview: After feeling unappreciated by her family, Lois taps into her villainous side and attempts to win "Best Customer" at her favorite coffee shop.

title: Who's Brian Now?
overview: Brian has a microchip that reveals he had a family before the Griffins, when he then seeks out. After meeting the richer, smarter Hendersons, Brian struggles to enjoy his life with the Griffins as much as he once did.

title: Young Parent Trap
overview: Lois and Peter are mistaken for "young parents" by another couple at Stewie's school and invited to live in a millennial apartment complex, leaving Meg and Chris home alone.

title: Meg Goes to College
overview: Meg deals with a college admissions scandal, while Brian embarks on a fitness journey.

title: Family Cat
overview: Brian tries to convince The Griffins that their new adopted cat, Pouncy, is evil.

title: Tales of Former Sports Glory
overview: The guys regale each other with stories of youthful athletic accomplishments. Cleveland was a teenage baseball player from Cuba, Quagmire was a bad boy tennis superstar from New York and Peter was an underdog boxer from Philadelphia.

title: LASIK Instinct
overview: With her vision waning, Lois elects to get LASIK surgery, but exploits her new disability for monetary gain. Meanwhile, Peter, Chris and Stewie must partake in all the activities with Doug that his father neglects.

title: Rock Hard
overview: While at an old record store, Peter and the guys recount tales of three rock legends: Jim Morrison, Muddy Waters and Elton John.

title: Must Love Dogs
overview: Quagmire meets an avid dog lover, and pretends Brian is his dog in an attempt to win her over. Meanwhile, Chris helps Stewie track down the culprit who stole his Halloween candy.

title: 80's Guy
overview: Impelled by nostalgia, Peter recreates movie scenes from his favorite decade; Stewie and Doug compete to retrieve a Frisbee stuck at the top of the jungle gym.

title: Brief Encounter
overview: When Peter and Quagmire accidentally switch underwear, they begin to mimic the other's behavior. Stewie and Doug agree to commit each other's murders.

title: Cootie & The Blowhard
overview: Stewie takes drastic measures when he thinks he is diagnosed with terminal cooties. Peter becomes infatuated with Bonnie's cooking.

title: Peterschmidt Manor
overview: Lois and her father attend the funeral of Lois' childhood nanny. Peter and the rest of the family turn Pewterschmidt mansion into a hotel.

title: The Birthday Bootlegger
overview: A new boss quells Peter’s favorite part about work: office birthdays. Stewie is put in detention and comes out a ruffian.

title: The Fatman Always Rings Twice
overview: In noir-style, Peter/Mac investigates the disappearance of Meg/Sister Megan.

title: Christmas Crime
overview: After a Christmas tree lightning ceremony Brian crashes into Mayor West's nativity scene causing outrage.

title: Mister Act
overview: An accident leaves Peter with a high-pitched voice, so Jesus coaches him into fending off the choir boys; Stewie is attracted to Lois' new masculine physique.

title: The Lois Quagmire
overview: At odds with Peter, Lois takes Quagmire to her high school reunion; the rest of the family must cover up the death of a pizza delivery man.

title: Lawyer Guy
overview: Peter hires the town's new lawyer, Brick Baker, to represent him in litigation against his new neighbor -- who turns out to be Brick; Brian and Stewie become lobstermen and save Rupert from the perils of the deep.

title: HBO-No
overview: The Griffins tell their own versions of three HBO shows: "Game of Thrones," "Succession" and "Big Little Lies."

title: Hard Boiled Meg
overview: Meg is invigorated by her new role as a getaway driver. Meanwhile, Quagmire can't rid himself of the hiccups and implores Peter to kill him.

title: Prescription Heroine
overview: After Brian sustains an injury, Lois gets hooked on his painkillers. Meanwhile, Cleveland refurbishes Peter's ping pong table, which becomes the hot spot in the neighborhood.

title: All About Alana
overview: When Lois' piano student, Alana, comes to work for the Griffins, Lois is initially glad for the help, until she realizes Alana's intentions are more sinister than she thought.

title: Girlfriend, Eh?
overview: Peter and Chris take a road trip to Canada to prove the existence of Chris' girlfriend. Meanwhile, Lois and Meg compete for the attention of a handsome handyman.

title: First Blood
overview: The guys' physical prowess is tested at Mayor West's dude ranch. Meanwhile, Stewie thinks he's gotten his first period.

title: The Jersey Bore
overview: Peter attends a business conference in Atlantic City with Preston. Meanwhile, Stewie helps Chris prepare for his role in Adam West High's rendition of "Romeo and Juliet".

title: Oscars Guy
overview: "Family Guy" retells three Oscar-winning stories: "Silence of the Lambs," "American Beauty" and "Forrest Gump".

title: Bend or Blockbuster
overview: Resolved to enjoy a family movie night, the Griffins take a road trip to Bend, Oregon, to rent a VHS from the last Blockbuster in existence.

title: A Wife-Changing Experience
overview: Joe accidentally sees Lois naked, leading to a reinvigoration of his sex life with Bonnie. Meanwhile, Stewie is gifted an electric SUV and quickly embodies the "Range Rover" lifestyle.

title: The Munchurian Candidate
overview: Lois hypnotizes Peter into satisfying her sexual proclivities. Meanwhile, Stewie renovates his treehouse in an attempt to win over Brian and Chris.

title: Unzipped Code
overview: Cleveland is fired as a mailman after an ignominious mishap, but flourishes in his new job at the brewery.

title: Happy Holo-ween
overview: Peter makes a hologram of himself in order to get out of menial household duties.

title: The Stewaway
overview: During a game of "hide and seek," Stewie takes refuge in Quagmire's suitcase, only to wind up in Paris. Meanwhile, Peter and Lois take a getaway to Vermont, where Lois is intent on breaking Bonnie's Instagram "like" record.

title: Get Stewie
overview: Stewie finds himself in public disgrace after a popstar unleashes her fan base on him for a benign comment. Meanwhile, Peter gets lap band surgery and enjoys the merriment of excess skin.

title: Carny Knowledge
overview: Peter and Chris finish last in a "Generation Gap" game at a carnival, forcing them to try to reconnect. Brian starts to date a carny, whom he can't break up with even after witnessing some of her crude habits.

title: The Candidate
overview: Stewie and Doug compete for the honor of class “snack captain”.

title: Love Story Guy
overview: The guys recount their first true love stories, leading to parodies of "Castaway," "Dirty Dancing" and various Meg Ryan rom-coms.

title: Old West
overview: The guys try to help Mayor Wild West reconnect with his estranged father, Old West.

title: Single White Dad
overview: Peter is mistaken for being a single parent, and relishes in the perks that come with it.

title: White Meg Can't Jump
overview: Meg joins the Adam West High basketball team, and her play is fueled by Peter's lambasting from the crowd. Meanwhile, Stewie goes down a rabbit hole of conspiracies, which ultimately ends with him developing multiple personalities.

title: Adoptation
overview: To restore his public image, Carter adopts a young girl from an orphanage, drawing jealousy from Lois.

title: The Bird Reich
overview: To take advantage of a work policy granting leave in the event of a pet's death, Peter adopts the oldest bird he can find... and realizes it used to belong to Hitler. Meanwhile, after giving Stewie a signed copy of his book, Brian finds it in a free library, causing Brian to give up writing.

title: A Bottle Episode
overview: Lois is blocked from a vacation rental app and accused of stealing after the family's trip to Nantucket. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian buy saltwater taffy in bulk, and try their hands at door-to-door sales in the community.

title: Vat Man & Rob 'Em
overview: When Peter gets a job as the new night watchman, he and the guys turn Pawtucket Brewery into an after-hours bar. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian's plan to collect "lost dog" return money backfires when Brian is used for a dangerous TikTok stunt.

title: From Russia With Love
overview: After Brian's Instagram is hacked, Meg takes Stewie and Brian to Russia, only to realize she'd rather stay there. Meanwhile, Lois reverts to her tormented teenage self when Quagmire starts dating her high school bully.

title: Adult Education
overview: Meg gets married in Russia but returns home after discovering she was used for a green card marriage. Meanwhile, Chris, in need of an extracurricular activity, joins Principal Shepherd in shooting pornos at the high school.

title: Fertilized Megg
overview: Meg agrees to be Bruce and Jeffery's surrogate causing a pregnant Meg to annoy her family. But, when the couple fails to pick up the baby, the Griffins must take care of their new family.

title: Supermarket Pete
overview: With the brewery under construction, Lois implores Peter to take a new job, but grows irate when he begins work at the grocery store. Meanwhile, armed with his police stories, Joe and Brian team up to write their own true crime novel.

title: A Stache from the Past
overview: When Peter loses the Griffins' home in a reverse mortgage, he and Mayor West travel to confront the man advertising the scheme, Tom Selleck. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian open a booth at the flea market, leading to a rivalry with Bruce.

title: Old World Harm
overview: Peter and Lois vacation in Florida, only to discover they've rented a condo in a retirement community. Back at home, Brian helps Stewie take his first shower.

title: Baby, It's Cold Inside
overview: Peter is emasculated when, on their anniversary, he abandons Lois amidst a shark attack. Meanwhile, Stewie finds a mini fridge and lives the dorm lifestyle.

title: Boston Stewie
overview: Stewie tries to civilize his half-brother, Boston Stewie, so that he may be adopted. Meanwhile, Meg and Chris start a venture in which people online pay Chris to sit on and smash cupcakes.

title: Snap(ple) Decision
overview: Winner of a Snapple contest, Lois uses her winnings to take Meg on a tropical vacation. Flaunting their wealth, the two are kidnapped. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian undergo "friendship therapy."

title: Baking Sad
overview: Meg discovers her tears produce delicious cookies, and her, along with her siblings, enjoy a profit until the success makes her too happy to cry. Meanwhile, Peter and the guys launch a "male talk show."

title: The Return of the King (of Queens)
overview: Lois decides to sell the family's television to help pay for Christmas presents, but when Kevin James gets upset over losing Peter as a viewer, he apparates into the Griffin house.

title: Cabin Pressure
overview: When the Griffins win a trip to Maine at Peter's company picnic, they decide to invite their friends on the vacation. Tensions run high and things soon spiral out of control when the cabin burns down.

title: Teacher's Heavy Pet
overview: Lois joins Chris's school as a substitute teacher, launching him into the cool kids club... but only time will tell how long he remains a member.

title: Take This Job and Love It
overview: Peter and his friends wonder aloud about what their dream jobs would be.

title: Lifeguard Meg
overview: Stewie and Brian become overwhelmed after winning a coffee shop. Peter and his friends annoy Meg at her new lifeguard job when they don't follow the pool rules.

title: Fat Actor
overview: Peter tries to protest Hollywood after learning that Brad Pitt was cast in a biopic about a politician. After Pitt injures himself on set, Peter must act out the role himself.

title: Faith No More
overview: Brian becomes romantically interested in someone and it inspires him to use Stewie's time machine. Strange consequences result from their journey.

title: Fat Gun
overview: This "Top Gun" parody chronicles Peter/Maverick getting together with Lois/Charlie, the tragic death of Joe/Goose, and Peter/Maverick's blooming relationship with Chris/Rooster.

title: Live, Laugh, Love
overview: When Peter realizes Joe has never found him funny, he is determined to make Joe laugh; Lois chaperones Chris and Meg's school trip, where she strives to reunite the principal with his long-lost love.

title: Drunk with Power
overview: Peter swaps lives with Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh and is forced to make a ruling on the constitutionality of gay marriage, meanwhile, Brett tries to become friends with Quagmire, Cleveland and Joe.

title: Lois C.K.
overview: Lois becomes a stand-up comic, using real life stories about Peter as content; Peter tries his best to straighten his life out to avoid being ridiculed by Lois's act.

title: The Chicken or the Meg
overview: Meg starts dating a chicken she meets on a reality dating show.

title: Dog Is My Co-Pilot
overview: After successfully landing a plane, Brian and Quagmire go on a press tour. Meanwhile Chris and Stewie open a boutique pizza place.

title: Pitch Imperfect
overview: Peter must gain his family's respect back after he makes a humiliating throw. Brian and Stewie become chiropractors.

title: Hard Times at Adam West High
overview: Chris uses Stewie's time machine to stop himself from having an erection during a book report. Peter becomes jealous when he sits out of a lottery pool and the guys win.

title: The Elle Word
overview: When Quagmire starts dating a mystery woman, Peter, Joe and Cleveland go on a stakeout and discover her to be the librarian.

title: A Real Who's Hulu
overview: The Griffins spoof "Only Murders in the Building," "The Dropout," and "The Bear."

title: China Doll
overview: When Stewie sees a tag on Rupert reading "Made in China," he heads off to China to meet Rupert's family.

title: One Foot in Front of the Mother
overview: Due to a police complaint about his excessive barking, Brian has to wear a shock collar; looking to join an after-school team, Chris discovers a talent for speed walking.

title: The Fat Lotus
overview: In this Griffin-family twist on the popular HBO series, Peter suspects Lois of betraying his trust with Quagmire at a swanky vacation, while Stewie worries that his wealthy new friends plan to sacrifice him in a volcano.

title: Cool Hand Lois
overview: Lois embarks on a journey of self-discovery.

title: Martian Meg
overview: Fed up with feeling like she doesn't belong, Meg enlists in a training program for a mission to Mars.

title: Row v. Wade
overview: Brian wins a boat on "The Price is Right" and decides to sail to Texas to help women seeking legal abortions.

title: Karenheit 451
overview: Lois becomes the leader of a group of mothers who want to ban books from schools.

title: Twain's World
overview: In an effort to improve his writing, Brian convinces Stewie to go back in time and bring Mark Twain to the present day, but the plan goes awry when Twain overindulges in pornography.

title: Episode 1
overview: Eşref Rüya tells the story of a young man who is a prisoner of a love whose name he does not know. Çağatay Ulusoy plays the character Eşref, who is reckless, has everything but is a prisoner of a love whose name he does not know, while Demet Özdemir plays Nisan, the young musician who makes Eşref's heart skip a beat.

title: Episode 2
overview: Nisan, who understands that she is in great danger once again with this incident, looks for ways to escape Çiğdem's games. Eşref cannot help but be carried away by feelings that he is unfamiliar with whenever he comes face to face with Nisan. Nisan's getting closer to Eşref causes alarm bells to ring for both of them. On the other hand, a great surprise awaits İzzet, who is drunk with victory. Eşref, who is preparing to make his enemies experience hell, will also face his new rival on the security front.

title: Episode 3
overview: After İzzet’s death, Eşref now faces an even greater enemy. Horrified by everything that’s happened, Nisan prepares to make bold moves beyond her limits in order to finally end the game. Meanwhile, with his plans progressing as intended, Kadir is willing to betray the Yetimler to eliminate Eşref from the picture. On the law enforcement side, Serdar investigates the murder at the hotel and comes face to face with Eşref and the tribe. This tense confrontation—where everything could fall apart at any moment—sets the stage for an impending major conflict. Though Nisan plans to throw Eşref into the fire to save herself, seeing a different side of him pushes her into an unexpected dilemma. Her growing closeness with Eşref is about to land her in serious trouble.

title: Episode 4
overview: Nimet’s abduction of Nisan and Afra signals that the war between the Yetimler and the tribe is far from over. Despite Serdar’s warnings, Eşref and Nusret continue to make moves that only fuel the fire of revenge between them. Kadir does everything he can to turn the Yetimler against Eşref. Meanwhile, his unexpected encounter with Nisan sparks unfamiliar emotions in Kadir’s heart. Eşref’s bold move to rescue Afra catches Nisan off guard. Now caught in a deep moral dilemma, will Nisan be willing to stain her hands with blood—if it means saving her sister’s life?

title: Episode 5
overview: Kadir's appearance as a rival in his deepening relationship with Nisan upsets Eşref's balance.  Meanwhile, when Nisan's closeness to Eşref draws the attention of the Gürdals, Nisan faces the risk of being exposed. While Eşref is convinced to end his feud with Nusret, a surprise development leads him to burn all ships. Eşref's final move will not only cause him to throw himself into the fire, but also his loved ones. Nisan will make a move that will shake Eşref's heart in order to prevent her secrets from being revealed.

title: Episode 6
overview: Nisan’s kiss leaves a deep emotional impact between her and Eşref. Witnessing everything from afar, Çiğdem is devastated. After Nusret’s treacherous attack harms his loved ones, Eşref is consumed by guilt. Unaware of the new trap being set for him, he begins to move forward with plans for revenge. Meanwhile, Nisan still faces the risk of being exposed and will do whatever it takes to retrieve the file. When Çiğdem finall

title: Episode 7
overview: Although Nisan is willing to turn down the opportunity she has for her career for Eşref, bigger surprises await her in the future. When the Yetimler's fight with the tribe begins to disturb the elders of the underworld, an unexpected development occurs for both sides. Meanwhile, Yakup Baba's worsening condition is a sign that there will be radical changes in the Yetimler. Kadir, who is doing everything he can to prevent Eşref from coming to power, has started to get closer to Nisan. Will Kadir, who is burning with love and lust for power, be able to risk betraying Eşref, who he promised to always stand by his side? Eşref, who agreed to confront Nusret Ağa at the point where the Orphans are in danger, will cause the balances to change again with a surprise move that will have an impact in the underworld.

title: Episode 8
overview: Although Nisan is willing to turn down the opportunity she has for her career for Eşref, bigger surprises await her in the future. When the Yetimler's fight with the tribe begins to disturb the elders of the underworld, an unexpected development occurs for both sides. Meanwhile, Yakup Baba's worsening condition is a sign that there will be radical changes in the Yetimler.

title: Episode 9
overview: While Eşref tries to protect Nisan on one hand, he also tries to find the identity of the person who betrayed her. While Eşref's absence causes the team to raise the alarm, Kadir, who prepared the plot, secretly follows the events. Çiğdem enters a big impasse with the move she made against Atıf. She is ready to take big risks to continue her game. While suspicions on Kadir increase, she will do her best to hide her betrayal.

title: Episode 10
overview: Eşref sees with his own eyes that the traitor is Kadir and begins to meticulously plan his next move. Kadir feels that the tension between him and Eşref is increasing and looks for ways to get out of the situation he is in. As Nisan and Eşref continue their turbulent relationship, it will become increasingly difficult to resist the attraction between them. When weapons are drawn against betrayal, those who want to survive will have to act quickly.

title: Episode 11
overview: Eşref kills Nusret, sending a strong warning to all his enemies. Realizing the gravity of the situation, Kadir senses that his mask is about to fall. When the time comes to confront Eşref, he understands it’s his last chance to set things right. Nisan is ready to confess, but she knows that once she takes that path, there’s no turning back. To get rid of Çiğdem, she must play her cards carefully and choose her words wisely. Meanwhile, Çiğdem’s obsession with Eşref reaches its peak, and she prepares to upend everything. With no tolerance left for betrayal, Eşref will make an unexpected move that will drastically alter his relationship with Nisan.

title: Episode 12
overview: Although Nisan knows that there is no room for love in Eşref's dangerous world, she cannot help but dream of a future with Eşref. Eşref, on the other hand, is in shock at feeling such intense feelings for someone for the first time since Rüya. While the ceremony to be held for Eşref's ascension to power is on the agenda of the orphans, Kadir is in danger of being exposed at any moment. Helpless, Kadir will have to take refuge in Çiğdem's insidious plans. Eşref, who is in a great dilemma between his position in the underworld and his relationship with Nisan, will encounter an unexpected development that will turn his decisions upside down.

title: Episode 13
overview: Kadir, blinded by his ambition for leadership, tries every way to seize control and is determined to crush everyone in his path. His collaboration with Çiğdem drags Nisan and Eşref into a dangerous conflict. In this great struggle where everything is turned upside down, Eşref fights with all his might to protect his loved ones. Eşref will face his nightmare while waiting to be reunited with his dream.

title: Episode 14
overview: Eşref continues to intimidate his enemies with the sentence he's enacted in prison, while Nisan rapidly climbs the ladder of fame. Kadir, driven by his lust for power, plots moves to force the Yetimler to deviate from their principles, while his new partnership puts him in the middle of an unexpected situation.  When a mysterious figure emerges from the shadows of Nisan's past, they ignite a war that will shake their lives, forcing their love to face its greatest test yet.

title: Episode 15
overview: Eşref has been released from prison and is now a free man; however, this time it is Nisan who is imprisoned with the grief of losing her sister. Even though Eşref tries to be by Nisan’s side during this most painful period of her life, the closeness that these two have with each other continues to be a threat to those around them. Following Afra’s shocking death, Dinçer puts his plan of revenge into place, as he continues to act ruthlessly while protecting his secrecy. Following the confrontation he had with Eşref, Kadir will continue his dirty games to protect his power, as he seeks a way to neutralize Eşref. As Nisan is trying to deal with the pain in her heart, she does not stop searching for clues regarding Afra’s mysterious death.

title: Episode 16
overview: Taylan's final pointer to Eşref makes him a direct suspect. While Nisan doesn't want to suspect Eşref, she begins to secretly question what's happening. Dinçer is determined to take his plan one step further to drive a wedge between Nisan and Eşref. Meanwhile, Gürdal's disappearance creates growing anxiety within the team. Kadir plans to use Gürdal to corner Eşref. Eşref must contend with suspicions directed at him while trying to protect his loved ones.

title: Episode 17
overview: Eşref, who took great risks to save Gürdal from Kadir, now becomes the target of the Russian mafia. Irmak, on the other hand, is ready to risk her life to learn Gürdal's whereabouts. Nisan, further confused by Dinçer's manipulations, begins to believe that Eşref may be responsible for Afra's death. Eşref, along with the team, tries to find Gürdal while simultaneously investigating the source of the slander against her. While Nisan tirelessly strives to find those responsible for her brother's murder, Eşref is willing to risk everything to clear her name and save Gürdal.

title: Episode 18
overview: Eşref once again faces the risk of imprisonment. Çiğdem manages to destroy the records at the cost of her own life, but this further fuels prosecutor Selma's suspicions. Kadir, tricked by Eşref, resorts to new methods to maintain his power and reputation. As Nisan and Eşref become more attached than ever, Dinçer prepares to take his plans a step further to distance Nisan from Eşref. With Hıdır's support, Eşref pursues the mysterious figure who has been bothering him.

title: Episode 19
overview: Dinçer’s fall down the stairs creates a new threat for Eşref, while Nisan is determined to do whatever it takes to protect him. Eşref is willing to go to any lengths to uncover the person who has been plotting against him. Meanwhile, Kadir, eager to secure his position, takes dangerous steps to expand his illegal operation. As Eşref follows the trail of the phantom pursuing him, he comes face to face with Çiğdem. Just when he believes he’s finally reunited with Nisan, he remains unaware that completely new obstacles await him.

title: Episode 20
overview: Dinçer, having fallen into Eşref’s trap, desperately tries to calculate his next move. But just moments before Eşref comes face to face with his secret admirer, an explosion in the hangar shatters everyone’s plans. As Kadir searches for a new base of operations, Eşref realizes it’s time to put an end to his rival’s growing influence. With a bold move that publicly tarnishes Kadir’s reputation, Eşref also finds himself facing new enemies in his mission to rid the market of illegal substances. Meanwhile, Nisan, whose new music video has everyone talking, becomes increasingly suspicious of Dinçer and is determined to uncover the truth, no matter where it leads.

title: Episode 21
overview: In the midst of a deadly shootout, Eşref and Kadir rely on their own instincts and tactics to survive. Though Eşref manages to make it out alive, he is forced to take increasingly dangerous risks to rescue Hıdır from enemy hands. Kadir, on the other hand, sees the chaos as an opportunity, using the crisis to push his drug operation to the next level. Meanwhile, Nisan comes across an old childhood photograph that sends her into a deep reflection about her past. Her inability to remember the other people in the photo gives Dinçer a powerful advantage, while Nisan herself teeters on the brink of confronting painful truths buried deep in her subconscious. As Nisan faces this emotional reckoning, the only person who stands firmly by her side, offering strength and support through her darkest moments is Eşref.

title: Episode 23
overview: After Nisan chooses Dinçer, Eşref ends their relationship, leaving Nisan desperate to fix things. Seeking an informant, Eşref turns to Çiğdem, and when Nisan hears they are together, her anger erupts. Meanwhile, Kadir prepares to uphold his promise to İhtiyar, but Eşref’s latest move hits him hard, dragging Dinçer into danger as well. Learning that his secret admirer is alive, Eşref finds himself closer than ever to confronting Dinçer.

title: Audio Commentary-Extreme Aggressor
overview: Audio Commentary on Season 1  Episode Extreme Aggressor

title: Extreme Aggressor
overview: After a fourth woman goes missing in as many months, the team is brought in to track down the guy before he kidnaps again. Hotch is asked to secretly evaluate Gideon to see if he is ready to work full time again.

title: Compulsion
overview: The team of investigators tries to capture a serial arsonist who has been terrorizing a college campus.

title: Won't Get Fooled Again
overview: Gideon and his team track down a copycat bomber terrorizing a quiet community.

title: Plain Sight
overview: The BAU team travels to San Diego to stop a rapist and murderer who commits his crimes in the middle of the day.

title: Broken Mirror
overview: The BAU investigates the kidnapping of a U.S. District Attorney's daughter and determines the kidnapper isn't seeking money -- he's after her twin sister.

title: L.D.S.K.
overview: The BAU is asked to identify a killer who is shooting at victims in broad daylight, and the team works with local law enforcement officers to recreate one of the shootings.

title: The Fox
overview: The BAU profiles a serial killer who takes families hostage and lives with them as a father figure during what is supposed to be their family vacations.

title: Natural Born Killer
overview: When an undercover cop in Baltimore involved in a mob investigation goes missing, the BAU believes a serial killer rather than organized crime has something to do with his disappearance. The probe leads to several unsolved missing persons cases.

title: Derailed
overview: Elle, along with many others, is held hostage on a train in Texas by a paranoid schizophrenic who is convinced that the U.S. government is monitoring him. Hotchner and Gideon are forced to play into the man's fantasy to save the people he has taken hostage.

title: The Popular Kids
overview: The team investigates the death of one teen, and the disappearance of another , which may be linked to a satanic ritual.

title: Blood Hungry
overview: While Gideon is stuck at the office on crutches, the rest of the team travels to Tennessee to track down a killer who disembowels his victims and supposedly eats their organs.

title: What Fresh Hell?
overview: When a young girl is abducted in broad daylight from a playground in a seemingly safe neighborhood, the BAU team initially believes her father is responsible. When he is able to provide an alibi, the team is forced to look for clues where the girl lives to determine who is really responsible.

title: Poison
overview: The team travels to New Jersey where several people have been poisoned, one of them fatally with LSD, ten times more potent than the street version.

title: Riding the Lightning
overview: After interviewing a couple on death row for serial murders, Gideon suspects that the woman is actually innocent. But since she's set to be executed in two days, it's a race against time to prove it.

title: Unfinished Business
overview: A serial killer reappears after 20 years of silence and contacts the BAU with the promise he will kill another victim in the next five days.

title: The Tribe
overview: The BAU team believes a dangerous cult may be responsible for the mass murders of five college students in an empty house.

title: A Real Rain
overview: The BAU unit travels to NYC to investigate a series of murders that appears to have been committed by a vigilante conducting revenge on former criminals who have been released by the justice system.

title: Somebody's Watching
overview: Reid finds himself in danger when he falls for a starlet whose stalker has turned into a killer.

title: Machismo
overview: The BAU team travels to Mexico to aid in the capture of a serial killer who is targeting elderly women.

title: Charm and Harm
overview: The BAU works to capture a serial killer who has evaded capture by altering his appearance.

title: Secrets and Lies
overview: The BAU works with the CIA to identify a mole within that organization, whose leaks are putting operatives at risk.

title: The Fisher King (1)
overview: While on their vacations, each of the team receives a clue from a psychopathic killer challenging them to save his next victim.

title: The Fisher King (2)
overview: The BAU team continues to unravel the clues given to each of them by a psychopath in order to save his most recent victim. Gideon decides not to focus on the personal aspects of the case. Rather, he tells the team to profile the killer as they would in any other investigation. Reid stays behind to work on a personal connection that could solve the case as one member of the team fights for life.

title: P911
overview: A young boy who had disappeared a year ago turns up for sale by a child pornographer on an online auction in Cleveland. A former profiler who now heads the FBI's Crimes Against Children Unit asks Hotch and the BAU to help her save the boy's life before it's too late.

title: The Perfect Storm
overview: The BAU has reason to believe a series of murders might have been committed by two people working as a team after the victims' families receive DVDs after each crime that includes psychological attacks.

title: Psychodrama
overview: The BAU is called to investigate a series of bank robberies after it becomes evident the crimes are not based on money because the robber abuses his victims by forcing them to undress before he leaves the crime scene.

title: Aftermath
overview: The BAU investigates a serial rapist who had been attacking young women at religious schools and stopped for six weeks. He has resumed his attacks, but is now targeting a different demographic of women. Elle makes a decision that could end her career with the BAU.

title: The Boogeyman
overview: The BAU travels to a small Texas community to investigate the murders of children. Meanwhile, Elle is having readjustment issues after being shot, and Hotch becomes worried about her when she misses a mandatory psych evaluation and isn't answering her cell phone.

title: North Mammon
overview: After a man kidnaps three teenaged girls and locks them in a cellar, he tells them only two of them will live and they must choose which one will die. The BAU team takes the case when the mother of one of the girls travels to Quantico to ask JJ to intercede with the FBI on the girls' behalf.

title: Empty Planet
overview: The BAU travels to Seattle to identify and catch a serial bomber who has been terrorizing the city and targeting centers of automated techology. Working with the author of a science fiction novel that has become a guide for the bomber, the team attempts to determine why certain sites have been chosen as targets.

title: The Last Word
overview: The daughter of high-powered diplomats, Special Agent Emily Prentiss joins the team, and she must convince Gideon and Hotchner she deserves the job based on merit and not on her family connections. The BAU is then called to St. Louis to investigate two serial killers who appear to be competing with each other. By setting a trap based on one killer's profile, the team creates a media event by which to capture the second killer.

title: Lessons Learned
overview: Gideon, Reid and Prentiss travel to Guantanamo Bay to interrogate the leader of a terror sleeper cell being detained there after a chemical weapons dispersal device is discovered during a raid at a suspicious house. Working with Reid, Emily's fluency in Arabic proves to be useful as they scrutinize the suspect.

title: Sex, Birth, Death
overview: The BAU is called to investigate a series of murders of prostitutes in Washington D.C. and Reid suspects a teenager he met asking for his help is guilty of the crimes. The case becomes complicated when a congresswoman, who about to make a speech to praise the city's lower crime rate, threatens to take away the case if Hotchner calls a press conference to discuss it.

title: Profiler, Profiled
overview: Morgan is arrested as a serial killer after he goes home to Chicago to visit his family. Because the detective making the arrest had used a profile provided by Gideon, the team travels to Chicago to help the local authorities find the real killer and exonerate Morgan.

title: No Way Out (1)
overview: Gideon is pitted against the scariest and most evil murderer in his entire career. When the BAU confronts the sadistic killer in a remote diner in the Nevada desert, the local authorities want to move quickly and make an arrest. But Gideon bides his time as he attempts to persuade the man, who has sworn not be captured, to reveal the whereabouts of a woman he is holding hostage.

title: The Big Game (1)
overview: The BAU is called to investigate after a wealthy couple is murdered in their home following a Super Bowl party.

title: Revelations (2)
overview: In this conclusion of a special two-part episode, finding the serial killer becomes critical to the BAU when the team realizes Reid is being held captive and a live feed of him being tortured is shown on the internet. Meanwhile, Reid's troubled childhood is revealed in flashback sequences as he drifts in and out of consciousness.

title: Fear and Loathing
overview: The BAU becomes involved to prevent a possible race riot when the murder of four young black women in a mostly white New York suburb appear to be hate crimes.

title: Distress
overview: The BAU travels to Houston to investigate a series of murders that have occurred near construction sites and abandoned buildings.
