However, Halis' rigid barriers make these peace efforts difficult. The Korhans meet with investors and, finally, announce the good news to all of Istanbul. Yet, an enemy emerging from the dark corners of the past is preparing to cast a shadow over this happiness. The Korhans need to stand stronger and more united than ever to overcome this challenge.

title: Episode 86
overview: Ferit and Seyran try to open a clean slate in their relationship. However, after everything that has happened, they realize that a normal relationship will not be easy for either of them. Big news from Suna and Abidin fills everyone with joy, strengthening the couple's hopes for their future. Esme, who takes a bold step for herself, is excited about the new restaurant she will open, while this surprise news changes some of their plans. Struggling to cope with her shock and fear, Gülgün finds support from Orhan, while Orhan starts to be unable to ignore his suspicions about Betül. While the Korhans celebrate the success of their new project, an unexpected enemy from the past has already taken action to cast a shadow over this happiness. The Korhans must unite once again in the face of danger.

title: Episode 87
overview: As the arguments between Seyran and Ferit increase, emotional and tension-filled confrontations occur at the mansion; these are indicators of the emerging family secrets. Suna's doctor's visit and the shocking news she receives cause Seyran to confront her own fears, while the veil of secrecy between Betül and Tayfun deepens. Ferit, trying to save the family from bankruptcy, takes a big risk by entering an unexpected collaboration with Suna, bringing everyone to the brink of a dilemma. On the other hand, a historical legacy that Halis Aga, facing the burdens of the past, will pass on to Ferit will shape both the family dynamics and the future.

title: Episode 88
overview: As the Korhan family finds themselves in the midst of a major crisis, Ferit sets out to follow clues to save his family from financial ruin. However, things take an unexpected turn. Seyran is shaken by bad news from her doctor. While hiding this truth from Ferit, who is eager to become a father and open a new chapter in their relationship, her relationship with Suna deepens. The Grand Lady brings the reckoning of the past to light. She devises a new scheme with Abidin to corner the Korhan family. Meanwhile, due to Abidin's past ties, his anger towards Suna and Ferit will lead to irreversible paths.

title: Episode 89
overview: Ferit finds himself in a life-threatening conflict by defying Halis Ağa's orders and is left alone with his desire to prove himself. However, his family's intervention shakes Ferit both physically and emotionally. While Seyran opposes Ferit putting his life at risk, she re-evaluates her relationship with him. As a mortgage crisis erupts within the family, the consequences of the decisions Seyran and Suna made in the past come to light. The events between Ferit and Suna, who are overwhelmed by family ties and responsibilities, will deeply disrupt all the balances in their lives.

title: Episode 90
overview: The closeness between Ferit and Suna prompts both Seyran and Abidin to question situations they never considered. While Ferit tries to confront his past, Seyran's efforts to keep him standing lead to shocking changes in everyone's lives. After the night she spends with Ferit, Suna begins to question both her past and her future, and makes a surprising decision regarding her relationship with Abidin. Büyükhanım's intrigues come to light with Naci's surprising confessions, causing Halis Ağa to see the true enemies within the family. As Ferit has a major confrontation with his grandfather, the balance of power within the family is reestablished. Whether Ferit and Seyran can survive this chaos remains a matter of curiosity.

title: Episode 91
overview: While Ferit and his family fall into the grip of a major crisis, Büyük Hanım’s schemes make everything more complicated. İfakat’s trauma brings the family’s past confrontations to light, and the moments when Ferit struggles to control his anger reach a point that threatens the family’s future. Meanwhile, Suna being sought after and another woman in the family being targeted further exacerbates the danger threatening Seyran and the other women. As Ferit’s desire for revenge pushes him onto a darker path, Halis Ağa tries to gather the family together.

title: Episode 92
overview: After an attack that leaves Seyran, Suna, and Ferit seriously injured, family members face both a physical and emotional trial in the hospital corridors. The chain of accidents disrupts the family's internal dynamics, bringing secrets and regrets to the surface. Ferit's support creates a breathing space for Seyran. During this challenging process, Seyran rediscovers her trust and love for Ferit. However, Ferit's reckless actions and revenge plans worry Seyran once again. The arrival of Cengiz, Halis Ağa's most trusted man, arouses curiosity in the house. His task is to keep an eye on Ferit. Büyükhanım's past confrontations and Abidin's mistakes shatter the family once again. Meanwhile, news from Suna, who is fighting for survival, takes the story to a whole new dimension.

title: Episode 93
overview: Amid great losses and betrayals within the family, everything changes for the Korhans. While Seyran discovers that Suna is alive, she is also confronted with a terrifying truth. As grief and rage take over the household, Ferit becomes blinded by his thirst for revenge. However, Halis Ağa tries to rein everything in, seeking alternative ways to protect his family. Meanwhile, the tension between Abidin and Suna reaches its peak. Abidin’s request to meet Suna one last time threatens to disrupt the delicate balance. While Büyükhanım revels in her victory, she wakes up to a nightmare—the fear of losing her sons shakes her to the core. Yet, to maintain her power, she sees no choice but to erase the Korhans completely. As for Seyran, her fury spirals out of control; she is finally ready to take action for revenge.

title: Episode 94
overview: Seyran and Abidin are worried about Ayşen’s health condition, while Büyükhanım tries to manipulate the situation to make Suna appear guilty. In a panic, Suna tries to prove her innocence as a major crisis erupts in the mansion due to Ayşen's fall from the stairs, bringing confrontations from the past to light. Meanwhile, Ferit experiences a major setback upon learning the seriousness of his grandfather Halis’s health condition. Taking on the responsibility of his family and business, Ferit, with Seyran’s support, is on the verge of making an important decision. After everything that has happened, Abidin and Suna decide to make a fresh start. However, Büyükhanım is determined not to let Abidin break away from her. Ayşen, waking up in the hospital, faces Suna and prepares to make some demands from her in exchange for keeping quiet. The Korhans are now more united than ever.

title: Episode 95
overview: As Ferit and Seyran investigate whether their car accident was intentional, Suna and Abidin find themselves caught in a major crisis. Suna is taken into custody in connection with Ayşen’s sudden death and struggles to prove her innocence. While Kazım and Esme desperately try to save their daughter, Ferit and Seyran work to uncover the mystery behind Ayşen’s death at the hospital. Meanwhile, the schemes lurking in Büyükhanım’s shadow grow even more complex. Just as tensions rise, Ferit discovers a significant truth that Seyran has been keeping from him, shaking the balance of their relationship.

title: Episode 96
overview: Ferit cooperates with the prosecutor to uncover the truth about Ayşen's murder and goes after Sadık with his guidance. Wanting to reveal Büyükhanım's true face, Ferit finds himself in a dangerous game while trying to get Sadık to confess his crime. While Seyran and Suna are in great worry about what happened, the steps taken by Büyükhanım to regain control complicate things even more. While Orhan and Kazım try to figure out Ferit's real plan, the information from Cengiz shocks everyone. While Seyran is angry that Ferit has put himself in danger again, he also faces a major crisis in his business life. The events involving Ferit negatively affect their brand and investors announce that they want to withdraw from the project. However, Seyran is determined to fight to keep the company afloat and put things in order.

title: Episode 97
overview: Ferit is deeply disappointed, thinking he was stabbed in the back by Orhan and Seyran. As the tension in the family escalates, Ferit's future at the company is in danger. Meanwhile, as Suna and Abidin try to overcome the tensions with their families, Karam's shadow falls upon them again. Suna decides to build a new life with Abidin, but Karam's dangerous plans could turn everything upside down. While Orhan tries to close the gap between him and his son, Ferit questions whether he is really ready to be a father. However, despite all the crises he is going through, he cannot give up on his dream of building a future with Seyran. Seyran and Ferit begin to question not only their love but also the idea of ​​starting a family.

title: Episode 98
overview: After a difficult process, Seyran and Ferit decide to get married for the last time. While sharing this happy news with their families, they have another big surprise. On the other hand, Serpil's secret and dangerous connections begin to come to light. While Karam makes plans to harm Abidin, Serpil also remains under his pressure. However, İfakat decides to make a secret move to eliminate this threat. As Ferit and Seyran begin preparations to step into their new lives, secrets and shadows from the past continue to threaten their happiness.

title: Episode 99
overview: Ferit and Seyran finally take a step towards happiness and get married. However, this new beginning also brings various tensions within the family. The whole family comes together on the night of the celebration. However, an event that overshadows the fun happens: Serpil's past continues to haunt the family. On the other hand, Ferit and Seyran prepare to open a new page in their lives. The couple, who plan to become foster parents for a girl from the Child Protection Agency, meet Zehra. Little Zehra's story deeply affects Seyran and he wants to know why her mother left her. As a result of his research, the couple reaches Zehra's mother and prepares to face a big truth. Meanwhile, Ifakat is conflicted about whether to make a fresh start with Cengiz.

title: Episode 100
overview: Duru, Seyran and Ferit's daughter, and Hatice, Suna's daughter, suddenly disappear. While the people of Yalı are in panic, the race against time begins. The first clues strengthen the possibility of abduction. The family reviews their past enemies one by one. While Ferit pushes his limits to find the children, Saffet's appearance in the images brings the dark accounts of the past back to the agenda. However, events become even more complicated. Tarık, Şehmuz and old memories are opened one by one. While Seyran and Suna are desperately waiting to be reunited with their children, time is running out.

title: Episode 101
overview: A turning point is reached where family dynamics are shaken, confrontations take place, and relationships are put through their toughest tests. As past reckonings are finally settled, everyone is forced to carve out their own path. While emotions and responsibilities clash in the decision-making process, life offers some the chance for a fresh start, and others the opportunity to close unfinished chapters. The Korhan family faces the most crucial choices of their lives, as themes of love, loyalty, and power are once again called into question.
